chunks: Musa ibn Sa'dan, al-Hannat (the wheat dealer), Kufan. He narrated from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him).
Weak, in his madhhab there is ghulw (exaggeration).
ai.seo_question: Who is Musa ibn Sa'dan al-Hannat and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry describes Musa ibn Sa'dan, a Kufan narrator known as al-Hannat, who narrated from Abu al-Hasan (AS). He is classified as weak (da'if) in hadith transmission, and his school of thought is noted for ghulw (exaggeration in the status of the Imams).

en.tashayyu: 8 – Mūsā b. Suʿdan, al-Ḥannāṭ (the wheat dealer), Kufan.  He narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام.
Weak, in his madhhab there is ghulw.
